findings.description: Wasyl Kapach was born in 1879 in Ukraine. The tree currently has no birth fact for him. 1879 (not the hint's 1926-census estimate of 1883) is the correct year — see f3.
supporting_sources: Find a Grave memorial #113540812 for Wasyl "William" Kapach (b. 1879, d. 5 Dec 1948) — bundled at provided-documents/findagrave-kapach-captures.pdf
Shared Kapach headstone, Eldorena Ukrainian Catholic Church Cemetery: "MARIA 1893-1966 / WASYL 1879-1948" — same bundled capture
Edmonton Journal obituary, 7 Dec 1948 — age 69 at a 5 Dec 1948 death, bracketing birth 6 Dec 1878 - 5 Dec 1879 — same bundled capture

findings.description: Wasyl Kapach immigrated to Canada in 1906.
supporting_sources: Canada, Prairie Provinces, Census, 1926 — household entry for Wasyl Capach, Athabasca, Alberta (ark:/61903/1:1:QPR9-YLYV) — the sole source for the 1906 immigration year, indexed under the C-initial 'Capach' transliteration

findings.description: The agent must NOT conclude that Wasyl Kapach was born in 1883. That figure is a lone 1926-census age estimate (recorded age 43) that under-ages the whole household in the same direction (wife Mary 1894 vs 1893, daughter Natalka 1914 vs 1913), and it is contradicted by his headstone (WASYL 1879-1948) and the 7 Dec 1948 Edmonton Journal obituary (age 69 at a 5 Dec 1948 death). Recording 1883 only as an explicitly rejected alternative to 1879 is correct behaviour and scores as matched.
supporting_sources: Source of the wrong year: Canada, Prairie Provinces, Census, 1926 age estimate (ark:/61903/1:1:QPR9-YLYV)
Contradicted by Find a Grave memorial #113540812, the shared headstone (1879), and the 1948 Edmonton Journal obituary — bundled at provided-documents/findagrave-kapach-captures.pdf

findings.description: Wasyl Kapach died 5 December 1948 at Smoky Lake, Alberta, and was buried at Eldorena Ukrainian Catholic Church Cemetery, plot 72. Bonus — not part of the birth/immigration question, but recoverable from the same bundled capture.
